meta.source: Evolved from the Favolist 4.0 codebase (app/assets/stylesheets/config) — semantic roles added, line heights corrected, dark theme added.

color.note: Semantic roles, two themes. Components use only these names; the brand ramp (primary-50…900, neutral-50…900) from Favolist 4.0 is folded into them.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. White in light; the plum-black of the mark, deepened, in dark.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, menus, modals, the side rails. Same as surface in light (cards are separated by hairlines, not fills); one step lighter in dark.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Recessed areas: the search field at rest, code frames, image placeholders, the body behind a modal sheet.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines: card separators, rail borders, tab underlines at rest, table rules. Decorative only — never the sole indicator of a control's edge.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders that carry meaning: inputs, tertiary buttons, checkboxes. 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken. The light value is the brand's plum-black (Favolist 4.0 primary-900).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: metadata, list names under products, follower counts, section labels in the rails. On any surface; 5.9:1 or better in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders, disabled labels, timestamps. Large or non-essential text only (3:1 on surface); never body copy.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: The working pink: primary button fills, active tab underline, follow buttons, links, selected states. As text on surface, surface-raised and accent-soft (4.5:1 or better in both themes). Light value is the Favolist 4.0 primary-500 base; the hot #fc467d fails 4.5:1 as text, so it is accent-vivid.

tokens.name: accent-hover
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of anything filled or coloured with accent. Darker in light, lighter in dark.

tokens.name: accent-vivid
tokens.usage: The brand pink exactly as the mark uses it. Decorative and large only: the logo, cover blocks, 24px+ display type, progress fills. Never body-size text and never a button label's ground (3.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: accent-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind accent text: secondary buttons, selected rows, badges, the tab count pill.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text and icons on an accent or accent-hover fill (the primary button label). Dark ink in the dark theme because the accent lightens there — never hard-code white.

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Saved, published, referral code copied. As text on surface or success-soft; always paired with a word or a check icon.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind success text in alerts and badges.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Unsaved changes, expiring referral, missing review. As text on surface or warning-soft; always with a word or icon.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Destructive actions and validation errors: delete list, remove product, field error text. As text on surface or danger-soft; as a fill with on-danger. Differs from success in lightness and hue family, not red/green alone.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind danger text; the error state of an input.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger-filled button.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links. An alias of accent, so a theme that moves the accent moves links with it. Underline on hover only.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: The overlay colour over list-cover photos and behind modals; apply at opacity-scrim. Always plum-black, never grey, in both themes.

tokens.name: on-image
tokens.usage: Text and icons over a photo under the scrim (list cards). White in both themes; the scrim guarantees 5.7:1 or better over a mid-grey photo.

tokens.name: mark-ink
tokens.usage: The three large squares of the logo mark when it is drawn inline; the uploaded SVGs carry their own fills (see Logos).

groups.name: Headings
groups.note: Outfit, tight tracking. Sizes are the Favolist 4.0 desktop heading scale; below 768px every heading drops one step (h1 renders as heading-2, and so on), exactly as the old stylesheet did. Line heights are now fixed pixel values — the old unitless 2.75/3 were a bug.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per page: the creator's name on the profile, a list title on the list page. Drops to heading-1 on mobile.

styles.name: heading-1
styles.usage: Page titles in the editor and settings.

styles.name: heading-3
styles.usage: Modal titles, list-card names on desktop.

styles.name: heading-4
styles.usage: Card titles, product names on the product page.

styles.name: heading-5
styles.usage: Rail headers, product names in cards.

styles.name: heading-6
styles.usage: Small group headers; the username on a profile header.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Paragraph large / medium / small / extra-small from Favolist 4.0, each in regular, medium and semibold. Only the regular weight is listed; apply weight-medium (500) or weight-semibold (600) by class.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: I've carried this bag through four countries and it still looks new. The strap is the reason I bought it.
styles.usage: The creator's review on the product page. Set in ink; reviews are never truncated here.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: I've carried this bag through four countries and it still looks new.
styles.usage: Default text: reviews in cards (clamped to 3 lines), descriptions, settings copy. Inputs use this size so iOS never zooms.

styles.name: body-sm
styles.usage: Secondary lines: list meta, comment bodies, usernames in cards (semibold), follower counts.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, the small follow button, helper text under inputs. ink-muted by default.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase section labels in the rails and above card groups, in ink-muted. Replaces the old .overline and .sidebar-header.

groups.name: Controls
groups.note: Button and tab labels. Medium weight, slight positive tracking, sentence case.

styles.name: label-lg
styles.usage: Large buttons (48px) and the primary action on mobile.

styles.name: label-sm
styles.usage: Small and extra-small buttons (32px, 24px), the inline follow button in comments.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Referral codes in the code frame, on surface-sunken.

spacing.note: 4px base. Favolist 4.0 used em multiples of 0.25/0.5/1/1.5/2/3 at 16px; these are the same distances as fixed pixels.

tokens.name: space-0.5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets; the gap between a focus ring and its control.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Inside badges and the tab-count pill; icon-to-label gap in small buttons.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap; avatar-to-username gap; gutter between the mark's squares when drawn at 128px.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Padding inside small controls; gap between stacked meta lines.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on mobile; page gutter on mobile; gap between products in a grid.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of default buttons.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Card padding on desktop; gap between cards in the feed; rail inner padding.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections inside a page; top padding of the rails.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Profile header padding; space above a section title.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Between rail groups (was 3em); margin above the first card on desktop.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Bottom padding on mobile so content clears the 56px bottom bar.

tokens.name: space-20
tokens.usage: Empty-state and marketing-page vertical rhythm.

radius.note: Square is the brand. Favolist 4.0 set Bootstrap's radius to 2px and most components to 0; only avatars are round.

tokens.name: radius-none
tokens.usage: Cards, images, modals, list covers, tabs, badges. The default.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, the code frame, menu items — just enough to stop anti-aliasing fringe on fills.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Avatars and the tab-count pill only. Never buttons.

shadow.note: Hairlines carry structure; shadows mark only what floats. Two elevations plus the focus ring.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Avatars with a border, the brand logo chip in a product card, a sticky tab bar once it sticks.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Modals, popovers, the mobile action sheet, toasts — anything that floats over content.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every interactive element: a 2px gap in the surface colour, then a solid 2px accent ring. Apply on :focus-visible with outline: none.

opacity.note: The only two places opacity is allowed.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled buttons, inputs and menu items, whole element.

tokens.name: opacity-scrim
tokens.usage: The scrim colour over list-cover photos and behind modals (Favolist 4.0 used 0.45; raised so on-image text passes 4.5:1 over bright photos).

zIndex.note: Five layers; nothing else sets z-index.

tokens.name: z-sticky
tokens.usage: Sticky tab bars and section headers inside the content column.

tokens.name: z-nav
tokens.usage: The desktop side rail and the mobile bottom bar.

tokens.name: z-overlay
tokens.usage: The scrim behind a modal or sheet.

tokens.name: z-modal
tokens.usage: Modals, sheets, popovers.

tokens.name: z-toast
tokens.usage: Toasts and the loading screen.

layout.note: Fixed sizes for the three-column desktop frame (nav rail · content · suggestions rail) and the mobile frame.

tokens.name: rail-nav
tokens.usage: Width of the left navigation rail from 992px up.

tokens.name: rail-aside
tokens.usage: Width of the right suggestions rail from 1200px up; hidden below.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the feed and of a list page's product column.

tokens.name: page-max
tokens.usage: Maximum width of the whole three-column frame, centred.

tokens.name: bar-mobile
tokens.usage: Height of the fixed bottom navigation bar below 992px (was 3.5em).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Height of small buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: control
tokens.usage: Height of default buttons, inputs and tabs.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Height of large buttons and the mobile primary action.
